title: Prompt löschen
description: As an organisation admin, I want to delete obsolete prompts including their history, so that the registry only contains relevant material.

acceptance_criteria.given: a prompt has two versions with scans and findings
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 204 and prompt, versions, scans and findings no longer exist
and: an audit entry without prompt content remains
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-012-prompt-delete.feature: Deleting a prompt removes its versions and findings

acceptance_criteria.given: a prompt exists in organisation B
acceptance_criteria.when: a developer of organisation A attempts to delete it
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 404 and the prompt is untouched
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-012-prompt-delete.feature: A prompt of another organisation cannot be deleted

acceptance_criteria.given: a prompt was created by developer X and is being deleted by the organisation admin
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 204 and the audit entry names the deleting actor, not only the author
and: the audit entry contains no prompt content
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-012-prompt-delete.feature: Deleting a prompt of a colleague is recorded in the audit trail
